title: SREV-046 process query token handle contract

data.output: caller receives a token handle or token-present flag only after safe writeback

contracts: info_data is a user ULONG64* output pointer and must be written through a try/except helper
opened token handle ownership remains driver-owned until info_data writeback succeeds
if token handle writeback fails, the opened token handle must be closed with NtClose and cleared
thread token object lookup under proc->threads_lock may only reference the token object or snapshot a boolean
user output writeback and token handle creation must happen after proc->threads_lock is released and IRQL is lowered
ptok and itok token handles use the same handle writeback helper

inside_lock.const: reference token object or snapshot boolean only

outside_lock.const: open token handle and write user output
